quest.s1.title: Save Bulpa!
quest.ch.clean: No mistakes (no edge, no short jump)
quest.ch.nostop: Press within {a}.{b} s on every block
quest.legend_warning: The hardest level in the game!
quest.legend_unlocked: 👑 The legendary royal eagle is yours!
quest.legend_locked: Legendary level: 3 eggs on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.legend_go: Legendary level: {j} jumps to the summit!
quest.legend_intro: Reach the summit to win it!
story.0.0: What a great day to jump together!
story.0.1: Help! The eagle is taking me away!
story.0.2: Hang on, Bulpa! I'll climb all the way to the eagle's nest!
story.1.0: An eagle feather… I'm on the right track!
story.2.0: Bulpa's hat! The nest isn't far now.
story.3.0: You came to get me! Thank you, thank you!
story.3.1: I've never seen anyone jump that well… Can I come with you?
story.3.2: Bulpa is free! New character unlocked: the Eagle!
custom.quest_locked: Finish Adventure chapter {n} to unlock it!
custom.legend_locked: Finish the legendary Adventure level to unlock it!

death.title: Slow-mo of doom
death.short_big: You needed to hold much longer
death.long_big: You needed to hold much shorter
death.side_big: The block was moving: aim when it comes back
death.ice_small: Just a hair past the center…
death.ice_big: On ice, land on the center or before it
tuto.s1.title: Hold… and let go!
tuto.s1.text: Keep your finger on the screen, then let go to jump. The longer you hold, the farther you jump! The green part of the gauge shows the right power.
tuto.s1.hint: Let go when the gauge is in the green
tuto.s2.title: Aim for the circle
tuto.s2.text: Land right on the circle in the middle of the block: that's a PERFECT, and you get more points!
tuto.s2.hint: Land right on the circle in the middle
tuto.s3.title: Grab the coins
tuto.s3.text: Jump onto the block with a coin to grab it. With your coins, you can buy characters and hats!
tuto.end.title: You're ready!
tuto.end.text: Here, you couldn't fall. In the real game, if you fall, it's over… but you can always play again!
tuto.almost: Not quite… aim for the circle! 🎯
guide.title: How to play?
guide.blocks_sub: Every block and how to jump on it
guide.perfect_sub: How to get lots of points
guide.b.normal_text: The everyday block. Jump on it to get 1 point.
guide.b.normal_tip: Aim for the little circle in the middle!
guide.b.mini_text: It's smaller, so it's harder to reach… but it gives you 2 extra points!
guide.b.mini_tip: Look carefully at the distance before you jump.
guide.b.trampoline_text: When you land on it, it bounces you to the next block all by itself. You don't have to do anything!
guide.b.trampoline_tip: Your perfect streak is not lost.
guide.b.moving_text: It slides from side to side without stopping. You have to jump at the right moment.
guide.b.moving_tip: Wait until it comes back towards you, then jump.
guide.b.crumbly_text: It has cracks. When you stand on it, it shakes, then falls after a few seconds.
guide.b.crumbly_tip: Don't wait around: jump to the next block quickly!
guide.b.golden_text: A fragile block made of gold. The longer you stay on it, the more coins you get… but it falls in the end!
guide.b.golden_tip: Jump before it falls, or you lose the coins.
guide.b.ice_text: It's slippery! When you land on it, you slide a little in the direction of your jump.
guide.b.ice_tip: Land in the middle or a little before it, never after.
guide.b.coin_text: A coin floats above some blocks. Land on the block to pick it up.
guide.b.coin_tip: Use your coins to buy characters and hats in the shop.
guide.b.heart_text: A heart gives you an extra life. If you fall, you come back to your block instead of losing.
guide.b.heart_tip: You can keep up to 3 hearts.
guide.p.how: In the middle of every block there is a little circle. If you land right on it, it's a PERFECT!
guide.p.streak: Make several perfects in a row: each jump gives you more and more points.
guide.p.lose: If you miss the circle, the streak starts again from zero.
guide.p.tip: A trampoline bounce doesn't break the streak.
web.description: Press and hold to jump from platform to platform.

quest.s2.title: Inside Abyss
quest.s2.legend_go: The Mariana Trench: {j} jumps to the bottom of the trench!
quest.s2.legend_intro: All 45 Golden Pearls glow in the dark! The Mariana Trench reveals its secret.
quest.s2.legend_locked: The Mariana Trench: 3 pearls on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s2.story0: Gulp! You jumped too close to the edge and Abyss the giant whale swallowed you whole, dragging you into the deep! Hop from reef to jellyfish to swim back up.
quest.s2.story0a: What a lovely view of the ocean… Hey! What's that giant shadow under the water?!
quest.s2.story1: HIC! Abyss has the hiccups and everything is shaking! Hold on, the way out is way up there!
quest.s2.story3: Pshhh! Abyss blows you out of its blowhole up to the surface. You're even now! New character: the Whale!
quest.s2.story3a: Abyss takes a deep breath… and blows with all its might!
quest.s3.title: Close Encounters of the 3rd Cube
quest.s3.legend_go: The Black Hole Horizon: {j} jumps to the black hole!
quest.s3.legend_intro: 45 Cosmic Stars aligned! The portal to the Black Hole is open.
quest.s3.legend_locked: The Black Hole Horizon: 3 stars on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s3.story0: Launched into the sky by the whale, a green tractor beam sucks you up mid-flight! The mothership aliens want to test your reflexes in zero gravity.
quest.s3.story0a: I'm flying, I'm flyyying! … Uh, what's that green light above me?
quest.s3.story1: A little alien follows me everywhere with a clipboard. Is it counting my jumps?!
quest.s3.story3: Beep-Boop! The Martians are amazed by your bouncing skills and lend you their top pilot: Zorg!
quest.s3.story3a: The mothership sets you down gently. The aliens applaud with all six hands!
quest.s4.title: Operation Area 51
quest.s4.legend_go: The Armored Bunker: {j} jumps to the bunker roof!
quest.s4.legend_intro: All the Golden Dog Tags are yours! Access granted to the Armored Bunker.
quest.s4.legend_locked: The Armored Bunker: 3 tags on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s4.story0: Red alert! Back on Earth, an army helicopter caught you in a net and is taking you to a secret base. Escape!
quest.s4.story0a: Phew, back on Earth! But what's that propeller noise getting closer?
quest.s4.story1: Shh! Searchlights are sweeping the base… and someone is watching you through binoculars!
quest.s4.story3: Mission accomplished, soldier! The helicopter pilot deserts the base to follow you: meet the Sergeant Major Colonel!
quest.s4.story3a: You leap over the last fence! Sirens, searchlights… too late, you're free!
quest.s5.title: Meltdown Alert
quest.s5.legend_go: The Reactor Core: {j} jumps into the reactor core!
quest.s5.legend_intro: 45 Golden Uranium Flasks gathered! The Reactor Core is ready to be crossed.
quest.s5.legend_locked: The Reactor Core: 3 flasks on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s5.story0: BOOM! The military base's reactor exploded! The whole area is flooded with glowing green acid. Jump on the floating chemical barrels before they sink!
quest.s5.story0a: An alarm is wailing across the base and the reactor is flashing red. This doesn't look good…
quest.s5.story1: Bubbles rise from the acid… and two big eyes stare at you before diving back down!
quest.s5.story3: You survived the radiation… and made a slightly slimy new friend: Toxik!
quest.s5.story3a: The acid finally drains away and the sun breaks through the green cloud. Something slimy hops toward you…
quest.s6.title: Sweet Insomnia
quest.s6.legend_go: The Lucid Dream: {j} jumps to the cloud castle!
quest.s6.legend_intro: 45 Golden Moons light up the night! Dare you face the Lucid Dream?
quest.s6.legend_locked: The Lucid Dream: 3 moons on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s6.story0: Worn out by your radioactive escape, you fall asleep… Welcome to Dreamland! Here you bounce on cotton-candy clouds. Watch out for clouds that fade away!
quest.s6.story0a: So many adventures… Your eyelids are getting heavy… very heavy… Zzz…
quest.s6.story1: One sheep, two sheep, three sheep… A figure in pajamas sprinkles golden sand along your path.
quest.s6.story3: Ring! You wake up full of energy, but your dream guardian followed you into the real world: Morpheus!
quest.s6.story3a: The sun rises over Dreamland. Time to wake up!
quest.s6.ch_coins: Count the {n} sheep along the way
quest.s7.title: Absolute Zero
quest.s7.legend_go: The Crystal Peak: {j} jumps to the ice throne!
quest.s7.legend_intro: 45 Golden Snowflakes! The storm parts to reveal the Crystal Peak.
quest.s7.legend_locked: The Crystal Peak: 3 snowflakes on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s7.story0: Brrr! As you woke up, a polar blizzard swept you onto the ice floe! The wind is strong and the ice is slippery: measure your jumps.
quest.s7.story0a: RIIING! The alarm clock goes off… but why is it suddenly so cold?!
quest.s7.story1: These footprints in the snow are… huge. And they're brand new!
quest.s7.story3: You broke the ice! The king of the ice floe joins your team: Frosty the Yeti!
quest.s7.story3a: CRACK! The big block of ice splits in two… and something furry climbs out!
quest.s7.ch_coins: Collect the {n} ice cubes on the way
quest.s8.title: Krakatoa's Wrath
quest.s8.legend_go: The Magma Chamber: {j} jumps into the heart of the magma!
quest.s8.legend_intro: All 45 Magma Gems fuse together! Dive into the Magma Chamber for the ultimate trial.
quest.s8.legend_locked: The Magma Chamber: 3 gems on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s8.story0: The ice melted in a flash: the super-volcano is erupting! Leap from obsidian stone to scorching geyser to escape. The rocks crumble fast!
quest.s8.story0a: The ground shakes under the ice floe… In the distance, the mountain starts to smoke. Uh-oh.
quest.s8.story1: A little flame is dancing in the lava and waving at you. Could volcanoes have a spirit?
quest.s8.story3: You made it out of the crater unharmed! The volcano spirit bows to your nerves of steel: meet Pyro!
quest.s8.story3a: The volcano finally calms down. A bright flame rises from the lava and bows to you.
quest.s9.title: The Great Clock Tower
quest.s9.legend_go: The Infinite Pendulum: {j} jumps to the heart of the clockwork!
quest.s9.legend_intro: All 45 Golden Gears mesh perfectly! The Infinite Pendulum starts swinging.
quest.s9.legend_locked: The Infinite Pendulum: 3 gears on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s9.story0: The blast of the eruption hurled you through the skylight of a huge mechanical tower! Leap from cog to steam piston before the machinery flattens you.
quest.s9.story0a: The volcano spits one last blast… and launches you straight toward a gigantic tower!
quest.s9.story1: CUCKOO! A little door opens in the clock… An automaton watches you, ticking away.
quest.s9.story3: Tick-tock! You reach the top of the chime right on time. Chronos, the head automaton, salutes you and joins your team!
quest.s9.story3a: DONG! DONG! You ring the great bell at the top of the tower, right on time!
quest.s10.title: Attack of the Giant Garden
quest.s10.legend_go: The Royal Hive: {j} jumps to the hive!
quest.s10.legend_intro: 45 Golden Amber Drops gathered! The Royal Hive opens its doors.
quest.s10.legend_locked: The Royal Hive: 3 drops on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s10.story0: A short circuit in the clock fired a shrinking ray! Now you're tiny in the middle of the garden. Bounce from mushroom to lily pad to escape the carnivorous plants!
quest.s10.story0a: Sparks fly from a strange machine… The ray hits you and you shrink!
quest.s10.story1: A huge beetle is rolling a dewdrop bigger than you. It looks friendly…
quest.s10.story3: You made it through the tall-grass jungle! Atlas the rhinoceros beetle lends you a hand for what comes next.
quest.s10.story3a: Atlas lifts a giant leaf with its horn: the way out of the garden is right there!
quest.s10.ch_coins: Gather the {n} grains of golden pollen
quest.s10.ch_bounce: {n} perfect bounces in the middle of mushrooms
quest.s11.title: Short Circuit
quest.s11.legend_go: The Mother Processor: {j} jumps to the Mother Processor!
quest.s11.legend_intro: 45 Golden Bits compiled! You've unlocked access to the Mother Processor.
quest.s11.legend_locked: The Mother Processor: 3 bits on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s11.story0: ZZZT! Trying to get your size back, you touched a socket and got sucked into an 80s arcade cabinet! Dodge the bugs and leap from processor to keyboard key.
quest.s11.story0a: To get back to your normal size, you touch a power socket… ZZZT! Everything turns into pixels!
quest.s11.story1: VIRUS ALERT! A scanning beam passes through you… and a little pixel antivirus waves at you.
quest.s11.story3: HIGH SCORE BEATEN! The firewall lets you out with Pixel, the system's antivirus, as your new ally.
quest.s11.story3a: NEW RECORD! The counter goes wild and the pixels burst into fireworks!
quest.s12.title: The Pharaoh's Curse
quest.s12.legend_go: The Chamber of Anubis: {j} jumps to the royal sarcophagus!
quest.s12.legend_intro: All 45 Golden Amulets are gathered! The Secret Chamber of Anubis opens with a deep rumble.
quest.s12.legend_locked: The Chamber of Anubis: 3 amulets on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s12.story0: A teleport glitch drops you into a pyramid buried under the desert! Sand is flooding the treasure room: leap from sarcophagus to pillar before the doors close!
quest.s12.story0a: The teleporter glitches… ERROR… ERROR… Where will you land this time?
quest.s12.story1: A sarcophagus lid is moving on its own… and a little bandaged hand waves at you!
quest.s12.story3: You find the pyramid's secret exit! Ramses, the little mummy woken up by your jumps, decides to see the world with you.
quest.s12.story3a: A wall slides open and daylight pours into the pyramid: the secret exit!
quest.s12.ch_coins: Loot the {n} ancient coins on the columns
quest.s13.title: The Manor of Shadows
quest.s13.legend_go: The Forbidden Attic: {j} jumps to the haunted bell tower!
quest.s13.legend_intro: All 45 Golden Pumpkins light up! The Forbidden Attic unlocks its padlock.
quest.s13.legend_locked: The Forbidden Attic: 3 pumpkins on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s13.story0: The mummy's curse has plunged the world into an endless Halloween night! You land in the garden of a haunted manor. Leap from pumpkin to candelabra without getting goosebumps!
quest.s13.story0a: The sarcophagus opens in a purple cloud… The sky darkens and the full moon rises.
quest.s13.story1: The candles suddenly go out… A white sheet glides through the wall, giggling. Boo!
quest.s13.story3: Boo! No harm done: Casperon, the manor's prankster ghost, opens the gate laughing and follows you.
quest.s13.story3a: The old gate creaks open. The bats fly off toward the moon!
quest.s14.title: Rock Symphony
quest.s14.legend_go: The VIP Encore: {j} jumps to the VIP stage!
quest.s14.legend_intro: 45 Gold Records on the wall! You're invited to the VIP Stage for the ultimate encore.
quest.s14.legend_locked: The VIP Encore: 3 records on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s14.story0: Nothing scares ghosts away like turning the volume up! You're on stage at a giant festival. Jump from speaker to drum to the beat of the shaking bass!
quest.s14.story0a: The ghosts surround you! Quick, an electric guitar… and one chord at full volume!
quest.s14.story1: The crowd raises its arms… and a rockstar mascot crowd-surfs over the audience!
quest.s14.story3: What a legendary solo! The crowd goes wild and Decibel, the festival's rockstar mascot, hops on your tour bus!
quest.s14.story3a: Final chord! Flames shoot up from the stage and the crowd screams your name!
quest.s14.ch_coins: Grab the {n} guitar picks on stage
quest.s15.title: The Cloud Dojo
quest.s15.legend_go: The Dragon Palace: {j} jumps to the dragon palace!
quest.s15.legend_intro: All 45 Golden Shurikens are lined up! The gates of the Celestial Dragon Palace open.
quest.s15.legend_locked: The Dragon Palace: 3 shurikens on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s15.story0: After the concert's racket, time for calm... A ninja master invites you to his temple floating among cherry blossoms. Careful: the bamboo pillars are narrow!
quest.s15.story0a: After all that noise, silence… A scroll drifts down from the sky, with your name on it.
quest.s15.story1: On the bamboo pillars, a young ninja jumps without a sound. Focus…
quest.s15.story3: Discipline, precision, balance! The grand master hands you your black belt and Shinobi, his best disciple, comes along.
quest.s15.story3a: GONG! The grand master ties a black belt around your waist. You've earned it!
quest.s16.title: Candy Factory
quest.s16.legend_go: The Royal Fountain: {j} jumps to the chocolate fountain!
quest.s16.legend_intro: 45 Golden Sugar Crowns tasted! The Royal Chocolate Fountain awaits for the grand finale.
quest.s16.legend_locked: The Royal Fountain: 3 crowns on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s16.story0: To celebrate your black belt, off to the final feast: a completely crazy giant chocolate factory! Jump from wafer to marshmallow over a river of hot chocolate!
quest.s16.story0a: A golden invitation comes fluttering in: grand banquet at the chocolate factory!
quest.s16.story1: A cream puff hops from marshmallow to marshmallow… and sticks its tongue out at you!
quest.s16.story3: Yum! You crossed the whole candy shop without getting coated in caramel. The head pastry chef gives you his sweetest creation: Choco-Chou!
quest.s16.story3a: The giant cake bursts into sugar confetti! What a delicious fireworks show!
